title: by-ref window results survive the bulk reset of the context holding them
live_proof: inspection at the 17.0 pin: release_partition (src/backend/executor/nodeWindowAgg.c:1335) resets partcontext and aggcontext at :1354-1355 and never touches ecxt_aggvalues, which :762 fills with by-ref results. The non-top-window branch at :2310-2331 DOES nullify them, with a comment naming the hazard -- 'Some of these might be byref types so we can't have them pointing to free'd memory' -- while the top_window branch at :2305-2309 sets the status and continues without nullifying. The unprotected branch sits beside the protected one; the pre-fix shape is present.
object: a by-ref aggregate result in the partition context
lifetime_ender: release_partition resets the partition context without NULLing ecxt_aggvalues[]
shape: stale pointer into a reset context
